summary: Iteration 11 — validated all 6 new requirements on the shared Bids table (Dashboard '/' and '/licitacoes'). Backend: 31/31 pytest passed including 2 NEW tests for PATCH /api/bids/{id}/observacoes (persists list of {id,text,color} dicts → confirmed via GET) and POST /api/bids accepting observacoes[] on create. Frontend (all PASS): (REQ#5) Column order verified IDENTICAL on both routes: Data/Hora | ★ | Modalidade | Portal | Itens | Objeto | Observação | Pregão/UASG | Status | PDF | Orçamento | Ações; Portal sits between Modalidade and Itens. (REQ#1) Observação column shows colored tags + dashed '+' button; no comment balloon icon (0 elements with that selector). Add tag flow works: clicking [data-testid=bid-obs-{id}-add] reveals input, typing 'TestTag_RT' + Enter creates a chip — chip persisted across reload (PATCH endpoint hit). Delete flow: clicking the X ([data-testid=bid-obs-{id}-remove]) opens a Radix AlertDialog with [data-testid=bid-obs-{id}-delete-dialog] containing 'Excluir observação? Tem certeza que deseja excluir "TestTag_RT"?' + Cancelar/Confirmar buttons; Cancelar keeps tag visible, Confirmar removes it AND removal persists after reload. (REQ#3) Itens badges render with alternating pastel backgrounds via tagColorAt — visible in screenshots (1,2,3 / 1,2,4 / 1,123,66 etc.) and number text stays dark. (REQ#4) Portal chips (Comprasnet/Licitações-e/BLL Compras) and Status chips (Disputar/Ganho/Perdido/Adiado/Analisando proposta) all render with dark text on colored backgrounds; status colored dot remains. (REQ#6) Six sortable headers found: [data-testid=bid-th-data_disputa, bid-th-modalidade, bid-th-portal, bid-th-objeto, bid-th-pregao, bid-th-status]. Modalidade sort verified empirically: ASC = ['Dispensa','Pregão Eletrônico','Pregão Eletrônico','Pregão Presencial','Pregão Presencial'] matches sorted() exactly; DESC click reverses it. Headers contain SVG arrow markup. (REQ#2) 'Filtros' button opens [data-testid=advanced-filter-sidebar] Sheet from right with backdrop. All field testids present: adv-data-from, adv-data-to, adv-portal, adv-itens, adv-clear, adv-apply; 6 adv-modalidade-* toggles and 7 adv-status-* chips. Drawer closes after Aplicar (visible=false). Multi-status OR filter validated: selected adv-status-Disputar + adv-status-Ganho → table shows ONLY rows with Disputar OR Ganho (2 rows out of 5, matches expectation); 'Filtros 2' badge appears showing 2 active filters.

issues: Radix console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. The dialog DOES have visible heading 'Excluir observação?' but it is not wrapped in <AlertDialogTitle> (or equivalent) — Radix requires the exported Title primitive. Cosmetic a11y warning, not a functional bug. Recommend: wrap title text in AlertDialogTitle and add AlertDialogDescription, or VisuallyHidden if you prefer to keep current visual.

action_items: Optional: wrap the AlertDialog header inside <AlertDialogTitle> (and add <AlertDialogDescription>) to silence Radix a11y warnings observed in ObservacaoTags delete confirmation. Functional behavior is correct; this is polish only.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/bids/{id}/observacoes (routes.py:242) does the $set BEFORE the 404 check — if the bid_id is invalid the update_one is still issued (it just no-ops with no matched_count), and only then the find returns None and 404 is raised. Suggest reordering: find first, raise 404 if missing, then $set. Minor (no data corruption risk because no match means no write), but cleaner contract.

ObservacoesInput.observacoes is List[dict] without per-item validation — clients can send arbitrary structures. Consider a TagObservacao Pydantic model {id:str, text:str, color:str} to validate shape and prevent garbage from leaking into the DB. Today the FE always sends well-formed dicts, but the contract is loose.

BidsTable sortable headers expose [data-testid=bid-th-<key>] which is excellent for testing — but the non-sortable th's (★, Itens, Observação, PDF, Orçamento, Ações) do not. Consider adding data-testid even for non-sortable headers (e.g., bid-th-itens, bid-th-acoes) for symmetry and future-proofing.

Multi-status OR filter is correctly implemented (status filter is now an array; rows where bid.status ∈ activeFilters). Currently OR-only — if you later want AND semantics across other dimensions (e.g., portal AND status), keep status as an array and treat other arrays the same way (looks good).

ObservacaoTags AlertDialog quoting: dialog uses smart quotes “TestTag_RT” (U+201C/U+201D) directly in the JSX template; works in all modern browsers but ensure the source file is UTF-8 (it is). Document this for any future i18n extraction.

rca of the issue: n/a — no regressions. PATCH /api/bids/{id}/observacoes confirmed by 2 new pytest cases + manual reload of /licitacoes after add and after delete.
